experiences.name: Founder & Lead Engineer
experiences.project: Ebook storefront for local comic publishing houses
experiences.description:
Sole engineer, taking the product from definition to production: scope, UX/UI in Figma, architecture, mobile, web and backend.
Partnered with 20 local comic publishing houses ahead of the 2027 public launch.
Built the ebook reader, code redemption and Mercado Pago payments.
Designed Argiro, a plain-text markup language whose single engine renders one story as a comic, screenplay or visual novel, and built its phone-first web and mobile editors.
Backend on Cloudflare (Workers, R2, D1) and Supabase (auth, Postgres).
Ship Android releases with EAS Build to Google Play internal testing; monitor production errors with Sentry.

experiences.name: Software Engineer
experiences.description:
Customized Shopify stores for e-commerce clients: themes, Liquid templates and new sections aimed at conversion.
Developed Shopify apps and led UI/UX redesigns of client storefronts, keeping them consistent with each brand.
Built web projects with React, Astro and Supabase.

experiences.name: Software Engineer
experiences.description:
Led a UI overhaul, modernizing the platform’s design and improving responsiveness across devices.
Built a new user hub where members connect, request guidance and access economic incentives.
Updated and optimized API endpoints in Node.js and Express backed by PostgreSQL.
Worked in an English-speaking team, contributing to agile development and UI/UX decisions.

experiences.name: Software Engineer
experiences.description:
Added pages and features to a Next.js streaming platform built on a micro-frontend architecture.
Improved the micro-frontend manifest schema.
Worked in a multinational, English-speaking team, taking part in code reviews and agile ceremonies.

experiences.name: Software Engineer
experiences.description:
Improved the main enrollment flow and built new sections of a Next.js portal giving employees access to tertiary education as a corporate benefit.
Refactored the API and wrote bulk MongoDB update scripts for data migration.
Worked with an English-speaking team on feature delivery.

experiences.name: Software Engineer
experiences.project: React Native expense app and gift box e-commerce
experiences.description:
Built a React Native app for a dairy distributor's employees to declare corporate card expenses, upload receipt photos and sync them to the API.
Redesigned the storefront and gift box builder flow of a Vue.js and Shopify e-commerce site, with Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager tracking.
Worked across Vue.js, Next.js and PHP codebases in a CMS-based environment.
